chapter_title: Multimedia Storyboarding and AI Asset Generation
title: Alt Text and Accessibility
description: AIL 606 textbook section on alt text and accessibility: classifying images as decorative or meaningful, writing functional alt text that carries the instructional point, moving dense data to adjacent tables, and auditing color-only coding per WCAG 2.2.

learning_objectives.statement: Classify an instructional image as decorative, informative, or functional and assign the correct alt treatment
Write functional alt text that carries an image's instructional meaning, and move dense data to an adjacent table or long description
Audit a visual for color-only coding and add a redundant cue per WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1
Apply the cover test and reject over-long AI-generated alt text with reasons

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
